_doc: Phase 12 D3-R2 (#386) — consequence hints. One line of muted text under a control, saying what happens to the store if you move it. It draws until the player uses that control, then retires; the InGameMenu's 'Show hints again' re-arms every one of them for the active slot. Retire-on-USE, not on 'seen once': a player who reads a hint and does nothing has not been taught anything yet.
_copyDoc: `text` is player-facing copy and lives HERE, never as a literal in a component — tests/HintCopy.test.ts scans src/ for it. It obeys the .claude/rules/ui.md plain-language rule: name the axis the control moves along, state the cost on both ends, never a temperature word.
_controlDoc: `surface` is the room the control lives in and `control` is that control's testID, so a hint and the thing it teaches can be joined without reading the component. The tracer ships the standing desk dials a player leaves running while the store plays itself — the three levers set once and then obeyed for days. `sourcing_lean` is the fourth such lever and is deliberately ABSENT: it has no rendered control anywhere in src/ui (persist-only since #293), so a hint for it would point at nothing. The rest of the live controls are #388's copy pass.

hints.text: List above market and units sit, costing you carrying cost every day they don't sell. List below it and they move quickly on thinner gross.
A bigger allowance wins deals you would otherwise lose, but you own that trade at the number you gave — you make it back on the resale or you don't.
Marking the rate up harder pays more on every financed deal, right up to where buyers walk and the lender sends the contract back.
